title: Post to Google My Business plugin for WordPress before 3.5.7 contains a blind server-side request forgery…
description: The Post to Google My Business plugin for WordPress versions before 3.5.7 contains a blind server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. Authenticated users with Contributor-level privileges or higher can exploit this flaw by supplying a crafted URL that triggers a server request to arbitrary hosts. This can be used to scan internal ports, probe internal services, and access cloud metadata endpoints, bypassing network perimeter defenses.
